metric_definitions.scope: One frozen category model, public training histories and targets only; targets may have influenced fitting. No additional scorer, checkpoint or ensemble is fitted or loaded.
metric_definitions.identity: At most ten loader batches. Require integer B x L aligned tensors, valid IDs, nonempty contiguous left padding. Match encoded suffix plus aligned target against every training endpoint; reject ambiguous matches. Canonically sorted eligible user IDs are sampled without replacement, cap 32; one event per user, local seed 42.
metric_definitions.candidates: Target plus up to 99 unique uniformly sampled alternatives, excluding padding, target and complete strictly pre-target history. Repeat targets retained. Same candidates across every condition; not host validation candidates. Supplied-negative margin is a separate two-item call and is unavailable for invalid or identical IDs.
metric_definitions.outcome_vector: Every outcome/delta vector is [raw target-minus-best-alternative margin, one-based target rank, diagnostic HR@10]. Descending computed FP32 scores, then ascending integer item ID; exact equality defines ties. Positive margin/hit change is better; positive rank change is worse.
metric_definitions.stage1: Corrupted minus clean on all completed eligible input draws, before numerical gating. Three draws/kind. Ordering uniformly permutes earlier occupied IDs, preserves endpoint and padding, requires two distinct earlier IDs and permits ten unchanged rejection attempts. Endpoint replacement is uniform over catalog IDs excluding original endpoint, candidates and complete pre-target history. Operational stress tests, not semantic counterfactuals.
metric_definitions.stage2: Conditions on any candidate absolute score difference exceeding 1e-6 + 1e-5*abs(clean score). Sites floor((N-1)/3) and floor(2*(N-1)/3) must be distinct and strictly before final block. Patch only the original maximum occupied position of a cloned residual output; recompute downstream. Restoration: clean donor into corrupted recipient. Disruption: corrupted donor into clean recipient. Each delta is patched minus its own recipient. No final-representation localization claim.
metric_definitions.contracts: Preflight finite FP32 features/scores, short-history original readout, duplicate-batch consistency, bounded future invariance, fixed-shape repetition. Capture hooks verify residual B x L x H layout, finite activations, zero padding and exactly one invocation. Each patch pair requires clean/corrupt no-op and identity-patch score agreement at atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5. Failure invalidates all summaries at the affected site; stage 1 is retained separately. Complete dependency paths and exported predictor parity remain unverified.
metric_definitions.summaries: Average realized draws within each user, then equally weight users. All/repeat/novel use original complete-prefix target repetition. Clean/corrupt and recipient/patched baselines are reported alongside changes, each on the same rows as its delta. Zero coverage is unavailable, not zero effect.
metric_definitions.common_user_endpoint_minus_ordering: Endpoint-replacement user-mean delta minus ordering user-mean delta, restricted to their intersection of completed eligible users. Stage 2 intersections additionally condition on site, direction and numerical gate. No comparison of ungated and gated populations as interchangeable samples.
metric_definitions.intervals: 2000 paired user-bootstrap replicates, local seed 42, percentile 95% intervals; fewer than ten users gives no interval. Same user indices resample all vector components and paired differences. Conditional on checkpoint, recipients, candidates, gate and realized draws; excludes training, search and candidate/corruption sampling uncertainty. No simultaneous guarantees.
metric_definitions.donor_summaries: Other selected users matched exactly on original encoded occupied length and original endpoint ID; no relaxed matches. Up to three distinct donors sampled uniformly without replacement, separate seed 42. Assignments reused across kinds/sites/directions when completed. During endpoint corruption, matching refers to the original clean endpoint. User-weighted descriptive means and pooled draw quantiles only; donor reuse prevents recipient-only intervals. Not an exchangeable permutation null or proof of in-distribution hybrids. Missing donors do not remove primary within-event results.
metric_definitions.coverage: Counts distinguish planned, attempted, completed, unavailable, gated-out and invalidated work. Remaining pending conditions are missing under interruption. Replay retains input IDs, target endpoints, candidates, draws, donors, raw completed outcomes and errors, including invalidated records.
metric_definitions.numerics: FP32 checkpoint required, autocast/TF32 disabled, deterministic algorithms requested and original backend settings restored. Existing CuBLAS workspace configuration is recorded, never established retroactively. Unsupported deterministic operations produce explicit failures; no automatic relaxed retry. Fixed-shape checks do not establish hardware/version/batch-shape invariance.
metric_definitions.budget: Cumulative synchronized wall time capped at 120 seconds/category, including preparation and GPU work, checked before bounded forwards and during identity reconstruction. A running operation is not preempted; elapsed time and overrun reported. CPU summaries and manifest writing occur after GPU timing. All computation consumes the host search budget.
metric_definitions.interpretation: Conditional training dependence only; no inferred intent, ownership, memorization, universal necessity/sufficiency, harmful stale interest, user causality or validation gain. Other temporal positions and direct embedding paths remain unpatched. Single checkpoint, training, architecture, score head, predictor writer, data splits and category routing are unchanged.
metric_definitions.readout_scoring: ModelView receives B x 1 x H features gathered at the original maximum occupied index and B x 1 x N candidates. This preserves its sequence axis while avoiding candidate scoring at unused positions. Readout and duplicate-batch preflight checks gate subsequent measurements.
metric_definitions.pending_donor_assignments: Recipients whose matching was interrupted before donor assignment. Their empty donor list indicates missing work, not an empty donor stratum.
metric_definitions.missing_patch_direction_observations: Numerically gated site/direction opportunities minus valid completed observations; includes interrupted and invalidated work. Raw records remain in the replay manifest.
